134099.creator: Mitsuya Otosu, Izumi
134099.description: Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest.

metadata.originalTitle: Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai

135496.title: Dandadan
135496.creator: Yukinobu Tatsu
135496.description:
Momo Ayase strikes up an unusual friendship with her school’s UFO fanatic, whom she nicknames “Okarun” because he has a name that is not to be said aloud. While Momo believes in spirits, she thinks aliens are nothing but nonsense. Her new friend, meanwhile, thinks the exact opposite. To settle matters, the two set out to prove each other wrong—Momo to a UFO hotspot and Okarun to a haunted tunnel! What unfolds next is a beautiful story of young love…and oddly horny aliens and spirits?



(Source: VIZ Media) 



Note: Nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho Award in 2022.

135545.title: Blue Box
135545.creator: Kouji Miura
135545.description: Taiki Inomata is on the boys' badminton team at sports powerhouse Eimei Junior and Senior High. He's in love with basketball player Chinatsu Kano, the older girl he trains alongside every morning in the gym. One Spring day, their relationship takes a sharp turn ... And thus begins this brand-new series of love, sports and youth!

141760.title: 100 Ghost Stories That Will Lead to My Own Death
141760.creator: Anji Matono
141760.description:
Forever Haunted

A boy sits in a room.

Alone.

Telling tales of horror.

One by one. Night by night.

The shadows breed terror.

Shall we begin?


One day, an elementary school child named Yuuma tries to jump out of his classroom window. His classmate Hina stops him and, in a bid to stall for time, asks him, “Do you know the round of a hundred ghost stories?” Hina tells Yuuma about a ritual where, if you tell a hundred ghost stories, you’ll see ghosts afterward. Learning this gives Yuuma a new lease on life. Chapter by chapter, he shares ghost stories with the reader, slowly but surely inching his way toward one hundred…

metadata.originalTitle: Boku ga Shinu Dake no Hyakumonogatari

142600.title: Takopi's Original Sin
142600.creator: Taizan 5
142600.description: Takopi travels from his home of Happy Planet to spread happiness across Earth, but meets the unsmiling Shizuka upon landing. Her friends at school and home life seem to be the source of her somber expression—and the pure-hearted Takopi is determined to change things for the better! But what truths await him when the curtains rise in this shocking drama?!

142769.title: Itsumo Shiotaiou na Osananajimi dakedo, Ore ni Kataomoi Shiteiru no ga Barebare de Kawaii.
142769.creator: Minamito, Rokurouta Rokumasu
142769.description:
"Today, I’ll confess to Kou-chan!"



A voice suddenly heard by Kouta Nitake, a high school boy who is not particularly popular. It was the voice of Ayano Yumemigasaki, a childhood friend who always has a bad attitude towards him.



Kouta didn’t know that Ayano fell in love with him.  



"I really wanted Kou-chan to talk to me..."



Kouta begins to be aware of Ayano’s unrequited love. However, an unexpected side effect of “voice of the heart” appears……! ??

metadata.originalTitle: いっつも塩対応な幼なじみだけど、俺に片想いしているのがバレバレでかわいい。

143113.title: Ura Baito: Toubou Kinshi
143113.creator: Shoutarou Taguchi
143113.description:
Ura baito, also known as a shady part-time job. A gray area job that pays very well. The price you pay is your life.



Yume Kokuryo and Nagomi Shirahama are in need of money in a hurry. To that end, they casually dive into various shady part-time jobs.


Note: Chapter count includes 15 extra chapters.

146982.title: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King
146982.creator: Gyeong-Bae Im, Sun-Gyu Gwon
146982.description: After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

147272.title: The Greatest Estate Developer
147272.creator: Hyeon-Min Lee, Hyeon-Su Kim, Baek-Gyeong Mun
147272.description:
When civil engineering student Su-Ho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book! Su-Ho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Su-Ho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world’s magic, can Su-Ho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?


(Source: WEBTOON, edited)


Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

150007.title: You're Under My Skin!
150007.creator: NAKTA
150007.description: Nuri hasn’t changed much since she was in elementary school. She still has a temper, she still lives in the same house, and she’s still tragically short. Her childhood friend Homil, however, has changed a lot. Several years after he moved away, Homil returns as Nuri’s neighbor and high school classmate. Now, he’s not quite the same boy Nuri used to know. Sure, he’s still an idiot and a good friend, but something feels different, and Nuri is all too aware of it in a more-than-friendly way. She might not be growing any taller, but maybe some weird feelings about Homil are growing inside of her…

162964.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
162964.creator: Masakuni Igarashi
162964.description: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

163630.title: Hope You're Happy, Lemon
163630.creator: Mizuki Kishikawa
163630.description:
Sunao Akiyoshi thought he’d left heartbreak behind after swearing off love in junior high. His first love, Lemon Nishikawa, shattered his trust by admitting to cheating on him with multiple guys. Now in university, Sunao is finally ready to try again, thanks to his crush on the sweet and down-to-earth Natsumi Kogahara from his film club. But just as he’s about to take a chance on love, fate throws him a curveball: he runs into Lemon again, and one fateful night under a shooting star, he wakes up in her body!



Now stuck in the ultimate awkward situation, Sunao has to navigate Lemon’s life—and his growing feelings for Natsumi—while figuring out how to switch back. To make matters worse, Lemon and Natsumi are roommates, leading to hilarious misunderstandings and shocking revelations. In this gender-bending, body-swap romcom, Sunao must face his past, survive his present, and somehow come out of it all with his heart intact.

164926.title: Suyo Webtoon-ui Na Kang-Rim
164926.creator: Kyung-Min Lee, Jun-Hyeok Song
164926.description:
Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him. 



The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her.

172903.title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koi Shite ii desu ka?
172903.creator: Ichiki
172903.description:
Jogo has a crush on his classmate, Miyato. One day, they unexpectedly end up walking home together after school. When Miyato is about to be hit by a truck, Jogo throws himself in harm's way to save her. In the final moment before impact, Jogo wishes he could have told Miyato how he felt. But then he hears a mysterious voice saying, "You can do it over. This time, don’t have any regrets." 

When he wakes up, he finds himself unharmed, lying on the ground, with a different version of Miyato beside him—she looks the same, but her clothes and hairstyle are different.

metadata.originalTitle: マルチバースの私、恋していいですか？

173231.title: Ichiban Toukute, Chikai Aitsu. Kimi ni Koi wo Suru Nante, Arienai Hazu Datta
173231.creator: Yasuyuki Nekoi, Katsura Ikada
173231.description:
Yasutaka Iijima, a boy wearing glasses, sits in the corner of the classroom and wants nothing to do with Ema Kitaoka, a popular gal in the same class.
However, after a chance meeting at the school camping trip, they started talking with each other, but only outside of school.
They are both unsure of each other's "true feelings."

metadata.originalTitle: 一番遠くて、近いあいつ。～君に恋をするなんて、ありえないはずだった～

176523.title: Horror Story Club
176523.creator: Aengmusae, Hyarop, Ojikjaemi
176523.description: On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?
